title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $500 on iRobot Roomba Plus 505
content_html:

If you're tired of constantly chasing the never-ending job of keeping your floors clean, maybe it's time to invest in a robot vacuum. There are plenty of brands and models to choose from, but if you'd like something that can pick up dirt, mop your floors, and navigate efficiently, check out this latest Amazon deal on the iRobot Roomba Plus 505.
